# 擇角 (Zak Geok)

> Fair Hong Kong meet-up points by travel time and cost.

Canonical: https://zg852.pages.dev/

## Purpose

Compare travel time and cost from each person's start place to find a meeting point that is fair for everyone.

## Features

- MTR, bus and walking routes
- Per-person time and cost focus
- Runs in the browser: no account, no backend, no API keys
